Ellen Park: Quick heads-up  new Volunteer & Community Service Leave policy effective 2026-09-01. Full policy: https://intranet.redwood.com/policies/volunteer-leave (TL;DR below)

Devon Shaw: Nice! Whats covered?

Ellen Park: Employees can take up to 3 paid days per calendar year for approved volunteer activities tied to nonprofit organizations. Activities must be pre-approved by your manager and People Ops (form link in doc).

Marta Ruiz: Are these full workdays or flexible hours?

Ellen Park: Either  you can take full paid days or split into up to 24 hours of paid volunteer time (e.g., 4x6-hour shifts) with manager sign-off.

Samir (Legal): Quick compliance notes: 1) This applies to FT employees and PT with >=0.5 FTE. Contractors excluded. 2) For international employees, local labor rules may supersede; People Ops will advise regionally.

Devon Shaw: How do we request/track?

Ellen Park: Submit via People Ops form (linked in the policy) at least 7 business days before the activity. Managers approve in the system; People Ops does a quick eligibility check within 3 business days. Logged time will not reduce your PTO balance.

Marta Ruiz: Any budget implications for teams?

Ellen Park: Volunteer days are reported separately and do not count toward headcount PTO budgets. Managers will see an aggregate dashboard but no per-event chargeback.
